rawFindings.title: Incorrect SHA hash assignment location in createPreprocessor
rawFindings.explanation: The SHA hash of the file content is assigned to file.sha immediately after invoking the first preprocessor callback with the original content. This causes an incorrect hash when preprocessors are present because the content may still be unprocessed. The correct SHA hash should be assigned only once processing is complete, i.e., after all preprocessors have run, using the processed content passed to nextPreprocessor.
rawFindings.suggestion: Move the line `file.sha = sha1(content);` from immediately after the first call to `nextPreprocessor` to inside the `nextPreprocessor` function, before assigning `file.content`, but only in the branch that checks if `preprocessors.length` is empty (processing complete). Remove the duplicate `file.sha` assignment from the original fs.readFile callback.
